Audiences.Description: Intended consumer of a skill's behavior. customer = end users of the suite; general = applicable beyond marked Effortless projects.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Logical PK — kebab-cased audience label.

schema.name: AudienceLabel
schema.Description: Human label as written in SKILL.md frontmatter (audience: <label>).

schema.name: Description
schema.Description: What this audience designation means.

schema.name: Skills
schema.Description: Skills tagged with this audience.

schema.name: CountOfSkills
schema.Description: How many skills declare this audience.

SkillCategories.Description: Functional grouping of skills as presented in the README. Categories are presentation/discovery groupings, not load-gate semantics (that's ScopeGateTypes).

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Logical PK — kebab-cased category label.

schema.name: CategoryLabel
schema.Description: Display label as used in the README section header.

schema.name: Description
schema.Description: What unifies the skills in this category.

schema.name: SortOrder
schema.Description: Presentation order in the README.

schema.name: Skills
schema.Description: Skills in this category.

schema.name: CountOfSkills
schema.Description: How many skills are in this category.

ScopeGateTypes.Description: When the harness loads a skill into context. The four patterns referenced in the skill-writing conventions (project-only / entry-point / tooling / theory).

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Logical PK — kebab-cased gate label.

schema.name: GateLabel
schema.Description: Short label for this load-gate pattern.

schema.name: Description
schema.Description: When this gate fires — paraphrased from the skill description's Scope (load gate) clause.

schema.name: RequiresMarker
schema.Description: True iff the gate requires the project to be a marked Effortless project (effortless.json + ERB CLAUDE.md).

schema.name: LoadsOnExplicitRequest
schema.Description: True iff the gate also fires when the user explicitly invokes the skill by phrase, regardless of project marker.

schema.name: Skills
schema.Description: Skills using this gate pattern.

schema.name: CountOfSkills
schema.Description: How many skills use this gate pattern.

Skills.Description: One row per SKILL.md under skills/. The 23 currently live skills in the suite. Deprecation history is in DEPRECATED_SKILLS.md, not here.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Logical PK — equals the kebab-cased Slug, which equals the directory name.

schema.name: Slug
schema.Description: Skill folder name under skills/ — also the value of the name: field in SKILL.md frontmatter.

schema.name: Description
schema.Description: Short pitch — one sentence on what the skill is for.

schema.name: WhyItExists
schema.Description: The 'why' answer — what failure mode this skill prevents, paraphrased from the README.

schema.name: Category
schema.Description: Functional grouping (Orchestration, Project Lifecycle, etc.).

schema.name: ScopeGate
schema.Description: Load-gate pattern (when the harness pulls this skill into context).

schema.name: Audience
schema.Description: audience: value from SKILL.md frontmatter.

schema.name: DirectoryPath
schema.Description: Filesystem path to the skill directory, relative to repo root.

schema.name: CategoryLabel
schema.Description: Display label of the parent category.

schema.name: ScopeGateLabel
schema.Description: Display label of the parent scope-gate type.

schema.name: AudienceLabel
schema.Description: Display label of the parent audience.

ConceptCategories.Description: Thematic grouping of cross-skill concepts (analogous to SkillCategories, but for Concepts).

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Logical PK — kebab-cased category label.

schema.name: CategoryLabel
schema.Description: Display label for this concept grouping.

schema.name: Description
schema.Description: What unifies the concepts in this category.

schema.name: SortOrder
schema.Description: Presentation order.

schema.name: Concepts
schema.Description: Concepts in this category.

schema.name: CountOfConcepts
schema.Description: How many concepts are in this category.

Concepts.Description: Cross-skill vocabulary extracted from surveying all skills/*/SKILL.md — named ideas/terms that recur across multiple skills and that a newcomer needs defined to understand ERB. Hand-authored, not derived from Airtable.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Logical PK — kebab-cased ConceptLabel.

schema.name: ConceptLabel
schema.Description: Display name of the concept as used across the skills.

schema.name: Description
schema.Description: Concise, concrete, instructional definition — 1 to 4 sentences. Must include the specific fact (exact command/flag/path/rule), not a vague restatement of the label. May end with a 'See <topic>' pointer to a SkillArtifacts row or the skill's full SKILL.md when real depth was deliberately left out.

schema.name: Category
schema.Description: Thematic grouping.

schema.name: ConceptSkills
schema.Description: Join rows linking this concept to the skill(s) it is most central to.

ConceptSkills.Description: Junction table: which skill(s) each Concept is most central to. A many-to-many between Concepts and Skills modeled as two 1-to-many FKs, per ERB DAG conventions.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Logical PK — Concept + Skill composite.

schema.name: Concept
schema.Description: The concept.

schema.name: Skill
schema.Description: The skill this concept is most central to.

Gotchas.Description: Specific anti-patterns per skill — what the plausible-but-wrong approach looks like and what the actual fix is. Extracted from each SKILL.md's explicit warnings; distinct from Concepts (definitions) — these are traps.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Logical PK — kebab-cased GotchaKey.

schema.name: GotchaKey
schema.Description: Skill-scoped unique key (Skill::title-slug) supplied at extraction time.

schema.name: Title
schema.Description: Short name for the trap.

schema.name: LooksRight
schema.Description: The plausible-but-wrong approach — what someone would naively try.

schema.name: ActualFix
schema.Description: What is actually correct, and why the naive approach fails.

schema.name: Severity
schema.Description: critical = silent data corruption, security hole, or breaks the core methodology guarantee; moderate = a bug or wasted work but locally contained.

schema.name: GotchaSkills
schema.Description: Join rows linking this gotcha to the skill(s) it applies to.

GotchaSkills.Description: Junction table: which skill(s) each Gotcha applies to. A many-to-many between Gotchas and Skills modeled as two 1-to-many FKs, per ERB DAG conventions.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Logical PK — Gotcha + Skill composite.

schema.name: Gotcha
schema.Description: The gotcha.

schema.name: Skill
schema.Description: The skill this gotcha applies to.

SkillBodies.Description: Point-in-time SNAPSHOT of each SKILL.md file, captured for the read-only rulebook portal's drift display. SKILL.md remains the hand-authored SSoT (see project CLAUDE.md) — FullText here is NOT a generation source, it is what the file looked like as of the last snapshot. The portal compares this byte-for-byte against the live file to show when a skill has drifted from its last-known-good rulebook snapshot.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Logical PK — equals Skill.

schema.name: Skill
schema.Description: The skill this snapshot belongs to.

schema.name: Path
schema.Description: Repo-relative path to the SKILL.md file at snapshot time.

schema.name: FullText
schema.Description: Verbatim file contents as of the snapshot. NOT regenerated from; compared against the live file to detect drift.

schema.name: Bytes
schema.Description: Byte length of FullText at snapshot time.

schema.name: Lines
schema.Description: Line count of FullText at snapshot time.

SkillArtifacts.Description: Hand-maintained reference/subtask docs that go deeper than a compressed skill body can hold — optional, freeform naming, referenced by a Concepts.Description 'See <topic>' pointer or directly by a skill. Tracked here so the rulebook stays the single source of truth end-to-end, even for material that isn't generated.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Logical PK — Skill + Filename composite.

schema.name: Skill
schema.Description: The skill this artifact belongs to / was written for.

schema.name: Filename
schema.Description: Freeform filename, e.g. 'magic-links-jwt-verification.md'. No enforced naming convention.

schema.name: Path
schema.Description: Repo-relative path, conventionally under the skill's directory.

schema.name: Summary
schema.Description: One sentence: what this artifact covers and why it's split out from the skill body.

schema.name: FullText
schema.Description: Verbatim file contents, hand-maintained. Not generated, not overwritten by any transpiler.
